scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.server.json --pretty false && tsc -b tsconfig.student-portal.json --pretty false && tsc -b tsconfig.student-portal-ui.json --pretty false && tsc -b tsconfig.notas-onedrive-sync.json --pretty false && tsc -b tsconfig.public-demo.json --pretty false
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run verify:build
scripts.verify:build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:student-portal:bundle && npm run test:student-portal-runtime && npm run build:public-demo:bundle && npm run test:public-demo-runtime && npm run build:notas-onedrive-sync:bundle
scripts.build:student-portal: tsc -b tsconfig.student-portal-ui.json && tsc -b tsconfig.student-portal.json && npm run build:student-portal:bundle
scripts.build:student-portal:bundle: npm run build:student-portal-ui:bundle && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.student-portal.jsonc --env preview --dry-run --outdir node_modules/.cache/student-portal && node workers/student-portal/build-edge.mjs
scripts.test:student-portal-postgres: npm run build:student-portal && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/runtime/vitest.postgres.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/smoke/vitest.smoke.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/frontend-foundation/vitest.postgres.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/admin/vitest.postgres.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/frontend-integration/vitest.postgres.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/student-portal/e2e/vitest.postgres.config.ts
scripts.build:public-demo:bundle: vite build --config vite.public-demo.config.ts && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.public-demo.jsonc --dry-run --outdir node_modules/.cache/public-demo-worker
